notes: ACCESS: HTTP-first only (curl + robots.txt check), no block encountered, Playwright/Chrome not needed. robots.txt is a generic Shopify User-agent:* Allow:/ with no anthropic/Claude-specific disallow. TREE METHOD: fetched live /collections.json (102 collections, cross-checked against a leftover stale scratch file beruru_collections.json which was independently re-verified live) and sitemap_collections_1.xml; neither exposed the site's real mega-menu structure, so also fetched the rendered HTML of /collections/door-mats and parsed its header-sidebar/nav dropdown markup, which revealed two tag-filtered sub-pages of the 'Decor' collection (decor/cushion-covers, decor/rugs) not present as standalone entries in collections.json/sitemap. Confirmed each leaf's canonical URL matches the requested path and product 'type' fields in the embedded product JSON (Cushion Covers / Rugs) match the node name. Site is a garden/outdoor-furniture and decor brand (Beruru) with top-level nav: Furniture (Seating/Tables/Cabinetry - all outdoor furniture), Pots & Planters, Sculptures, Decor, Fountains, Lighting, Tableware, Garden Accessories - no Storage/Organization section anywhere. QTY METHOD: rendered 'N products' header text on each live collection page (e.g. '37 products', '18 products'), not the Shopify products_count JSON field (known inflated - e.g. door-mats JSON says 25 but rendered page and unique /products/ links both confirm 18); Place Mats collection explicitly renders 'This collection is empty' so qty=0 per the zero-product-category rule. EXCLUDED: Wall Decor (/collections/wall-decor) - inspected embedded product types (Frames, Mirrors, Photo frames, Posters, Wall Hooks, Key Holder) with zero textile/tapestry products, so excluded from Textile entirely. Garden Accessories > 'Baskets' - only reachable via a filter.p.product_type= query param (not a real category URL per URL rules) and is a gardening/planting-tool basket, not home storage - excluded. Shelves (/collections/shelves) sits under the FURNITURE > CABINETRY nav branch, explicitly a furniture subcategory on this site - excluded from Storage. Rain Chains/Vases/Mirrors/Sculptures under Decor are filter-param URLs and non-textile - excluded. No genuine Storage/Organization/Basket/Bin/Organizer category exists anywhere in the full collections.json enumeration or sitemap - storage_rows is empty, this is a correct NO_CATEGORY result for Storage, not a missed search.
